description.zh:
需要查询的角色权限名称。支持输入多个规则名称进行批量查询，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> * 您可以通过接口[DescribeEncryptionDBRolePrivilege](~~212573~~)查看目标集群下的所有角色策略规则详情，包括规则名称。
description.en:
The name of the role permission to query. To query multiple permissions at a time, enter multiple permission names and separate them with commas (,).

> - Call the [DescribeEncryptionDBRolePrivilege](~~212573~~) operation to view the details of all role access policy rules for the cluster. The details include the permission names.

title.zh: 获取角色权限名称列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-encryption-db-role-privilege --db-cluster-id pc-wz9fb5nn44u1d0000 --role-privilege-name-list test --region cn-hangzhou
